{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders: only completed orders count for conversion rate
# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate within each segment
conversion_by_segment = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search) within each segment
email_rates = conversion_by_segment[conversion_by_segment['channel'] == 'email'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted']
paid_search_rates = conversion_by_segment[conversion_by_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted']

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
diff_by_segment = email_rates - paid_search_rates

# Print the differences by segment
print("Difference in conversion rates by segment (email - paid_search):")
print(diff_by_segment)

# Compute the overall difference (raw) for comparison
overall_diff = conversion_by_segment[conversion_by_segment['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean() - \
               conversion_by_segment[conversion_by_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

print(f"\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {overall_diff:.4f}")"}
